svg.title: CardTally compact-width primitive and state showcase
svg.desc: A non-product design-system board showing foundations, navigation variants, headers, controls, overview and dense cards, category depth stress, keypad, overlays, chat, feedback, and accessibility states.

g.aria-label: Foundations: color, type, spacing, radius, and depth
g.text: 1dp cool-gray edge · top-center light · no glass / gradients

g.aria-label: Three, four, and five destination navigation variants
g.text: Selected = pale cyan + marker + weight · 48dp targets

g.aria-label: Headers, buttons, states, and floating action button
Overview profile summary, asset, record, and settings cards
g.text: 20dp padding · 12/16dp outer radius · no nested row cards
SETTINGS GROUP · ONE OUTLINE / THREE ROWS

g.aria-label: Dense record rows and 200 plus record stress pattern
g.text: RecyclerView · 52dp rows · date groups · no stagger
Rows share this outline; no row has its own card or shadow.
Only levels 1–4 indent · L5–L50 hold text column
CATEGORY TREE · PARENT EXPANDS / LEAF SELECTS
受保护父分类 / Protected parent
Tree item · value · state · action: Select category

g.aria-label: Segmented controls, filters, fields, and fixed keypad
g.text: FIXED IN-PAGE KEYPAD · NO SYSTEM KEYBOARD
Every key ≥48dp · Long press Backspace: Clear amount

g.aria-label: Bottom sheet and dialog overlays with accessibility annotations
g.text: Focus trap · Back dismiss · focus returns to trigger
This category still has child items.
Move or delete them before continuing.
返回分类 / Back to categories
Motion: card/sheet slide 260ms · Reduced motion: fade only 120ms

g.aria-label: Chat bubbles, session rows, partial errors, and generating skeleton
g.text: Plain text assistance, no AI theater
已收到部分回复，连接已中断。

g.aria-label: Skeleton, inline error, empty state, and undo Snackbar
g.text: Create one when you want to start.
Polite live region · announces restoration once · never covers fixed UI

g.aria-label: Per-primitive accessibility, state, reduced-motion, and enlarged-text evidence
g.text: Default / press / focus / selected / disabled · reduce: marker fade
Default / press / focus / disabled · reduce: color change only
Group/row role · signed value · current state · Open/Edit/Delete
Actionable only: press / focus · other states: see specimens
Reduce: no row entrance · immediate status swap
Default / press / focus / selected / disabled · keys ≥48dp
Reduce: indicator fade; key surface change without scale
Focus trap · Back dismiss · return focus to trigger
Sender + message; session Button · selected · Switch/Rename
Skeleton hidden; owner announces once; Undo announces restoration once
Reduce: skeleton static; Snackbar fade only

svg.text: Primitive gate only · local SVG · no product screens
Connected ADB QA not run · runtime proof deferred
